headline: As of 2026-10-28: 38,273,649 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 38,273,649 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,705,412), California (3,768,035), Florida (3,661,245).
